messages.subject: Query on WebSockets and Server.R
parts:
Hi,

I am new to this world so please excuse my ignorance.

Problem Statement:  
1. My server.R is housed on the cloud in the EMEA region and my user base is mostly in ASIA and US.  So they experience latency issues when transfer of material data takes place.  I believe the ui.R and server.R use websockets to communicate among each other.

Proposed Resolution:
1. Instead of using a CDN which could be expensive, was wondering if I could have a server.R file in droplets located in different regions like ASIA, EMEA and US.
2. Now when a user session begins, a small JQuery onPageLoad can determine the location of the user and then based on that choose the server to connect to using websockets.

var connection = new WebSocket('ws:IP:8787', 'json');
connection.onopen = function () {
  console.log('Connection Opened');
};

Is the above strategy feasible in shiny?  This will take care of my latency issues.

Appreciate your thoughts.
